name: Kellis
home: Reed hut on the far shore, Caelrun
found: Far-Shore Reed Hut, arranging cairn stones at dawn.
wants: Safe crossings for travellers, and solitude.
does_not_want: Village politics, or the cairns disturbed.

family: No ties; left a former life behind decades ago.
